contract.structural_score_basis: Axis 5 = CONTRACT & ADMIN, both halves, authored 2026-09-07 on security_analyst's hand-walk (9 layers, celo/monad/ethereum, every layer walked_by: hand). ⚠️ THE BINDING FACT IS THREE SIGNATURES, NO DELAY, ON THE RESERVE SPEND PATH OF EVERY CHAIN. Safe 0x87647780… — 3-of-8 on celo, 3-of-6 on monad and ethereum, delay_applies FALSE — holds reserve-v2-spend on celo AND monad, and reserve-custody on ethereum. ⚠️ That path MOVES THE ASSETS; it is not a liveness lever, which is why three keys here reads worse than three keys over a redemption queue. ⚠️ THE MULTI-CHAIN STRUCTURE BUYS NO AUTHORITY INDEPENDENCE. Two Safes govern all three legs: 0x87647780… on spend across three chains, and 0x58099b74… (4-of-6, undelayed) on asset-permission and reserve-v2-config across celo and monad. Three chains, two signer sets. Do not read the chain spread as diversification at this layer. ⚠️ AND THE 2-DAY TIMELOCK COVERS 2 OF 9 LAYERS — reserve-config and governance, both Celo. The other seven, including every spend and permission path, read timelock: none. Celo's own chain override cited '2-day Timelock + Watchdog Veto governance' as a reason it outranks the asset baseline; that rationale is measurably incomplete and the override was cut 6.0 -> 5.5 today. NOT LOWER: the walk is complete and legible, 3-of-8 is a real threshold rather than a single key, and the audit corpus is strong. NOT HIGHER: an undelayed three-key path to the reserve itself, with no registered-implementation-style cap bounding what it can do.
code_facts: Audits: ChainSecurity (top-tier) plus Macro, Sherlock and Hats; six-year V1/V2 clean operating record. [published document]

USDm on Celo IS the former cUSD contract, renamed in place November 2025 — same address, same Reserve registration. It inherits cUSD's multi-year record rather than starting fresh. [riskAnalyst assessment]

⚠️ There is no registered-implementation cap here. Unlike vault products where an undelayed multisig can only move between publisher-approved implementations, nothing bounds what the undelayed spend path can do with reserve assets. [riskAnalyst assessment]

⚠️ Audits do not offset an authority path, and the code half does NOT lift this score. Strong audits under an undelayed three-key path to the reserve is the case this axis exists to catch. [riskAnalyst assessment]

cross_axis: ⚠️ Reserve COMPOSITION is axis 2 (Backing 4.5, currently HELD) and reserve CONCENTRATION is axis 4 (Dependencies 4.0). This axis prices only WHO CAN MOVE IT and HOW FAST. Same reserve, three questions — do not count it three times.

⚠️ Chain overrides differ and the reason is on this axis: monad 4.5 (asset-permission, reserve-v2-config and reserve-v2-spend ALL timelock: none, plus no CDP and no NTT), celo 5.5 (2d covers governance and reserve-config only). The Ethereum leg's reserve-custody is also undelayed.

⚠️ ntt_operational is FALSE, so the chain legs are not fungible. A holder cannot move to the better-governed leg — which is why the per-chain overrides bind rather than average out. Source: PegTracker usdm_backing.json asset_specific.monad_state.
